title: Mastre Gaming game manifest
description: mastre.json, at the root of a game repo. Tells the Mastre Gaming hub how to build the game and how to list it.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Always 1 for now.

id.description: Unique across the hub and permanent: it becomes the URL folder (/games/<id>/) and the storage prefix (mastre:<id>:).

description.description: One or two sentences shown on the launcher.

cover.description: Path in the repo to a 16:9 cover image (1200x675 recommended, PNG, JPG or WebP, under 500 KB).

build.description: How to produce the static build on a clean Linux machine with Node 20. null for a game with no build step.

install.description: Command that installs dependencies, e.g. "npm ci". null or omitted to skip.

command.description: Command that builds the game, e.g. "npm run build". null or omitted to skip.

output.description: Folder, relative to the repo root, that holds the finished static build.
Only used when build is null: the folder to publish. Defaults to "." (the repo root).

entry.description: The HTML file inside the build output that starts the game.

server.description: null, or the public wss:// or https:// URL of the game's own backend. The hub only hosts static files.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the repo root: forward slashes, no leading "/", no ".." segment.
